aggregation_notes.policy: Dish cases assert a dish-title expectation (at least one top-5 title names the dish); ingredient cases assert discovery is preserved (the phrase query still returns phrase carriers). Pairs share an aggregate_group so future aggregate scoring can count each intent once.

cases.notes: Dish request adobo (H6, 2026-10-08). Corpus: 14 titles name adobo, 26 documents carry the ingredient phrase chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, 78 full-text matches. Current ranking top-5 holds 0 adobo titles (Turkey Chili, Onion Rings, Carnitas, Fish Tacos, Burrito Bowl). Title-first returns adobo titles; title-boost should recover most without unconditional precedence.

Ingredient-discovery control for the adobo pair (H6, 2026-10-08). The phrase query matches 44 documents; discovery must keep returning phrase carriers (Turkey Chili, Crab Cakes, Meatloaf) and must not be reordered by the dish title boost.

Dish request tzatziki (H6, 2026-10-08). Corpus: 3 titles name tzatziki (Greek Tzatziki, Tzatziki Guacamole, Falafel with Tzatziki), 32 full-text matches. Current top-5 holds 1 title hit; the rest are gyro, kebab and salmon dishes carrying tzatziki as a condiment.

Ingredient-discovery control for the tzatziki pair (H6, 2026-10-08). The gyro-phrase query matches 7 documents; discovery must keep returning gyro dishes and must not be reordered by the dish title boost.

Dish request hollandaise (H6, 2026-10-08). Corpus: 1 title names hollandaise (Blender Hollandaise Sauce), 5 full-text matches. Current top-5 holds the sauce at rank 4 behind Eggs Benedict, a known-malformed summary record at rank 2, and an omelet; the sauce is a component of the other dishes, not their identity.

Ingredient-discovery control for the hollandaise pair (H6, 2026-10-08). The benedict-phrase query matches 3 documents including a known-malformed summary record; discovery must keep returning benedict dishes and must not be reordered by the dish title boost.
